search_text: published ZDI-15-403 ZDI-CAN-2883 Hewlett-Packard KeyView IDOL AutoCAD Parsing Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2015-08-24 CVE-2015-5422 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2015-5422 7.5 ['Hewlett-Packard'] ['KeyView IDOL'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Hewlett-Packard KeyView IDOL. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The flaw exists within the handling of AutoCAD files. It is possible to trigger an out-of-bounds write when handling malformed header data within an AutoCAD file. A remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code under the context of the process. Hewlett-Packard has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Hewlett-Packard KeyView IDOL AutoCAD Parsing Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Hewlett-Packard KeyView IDOL. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The flaw exists within the handling of AutoCAD files. It is possible to trigger an out-of-bounds write when handling malformed header data within an AutoCAD file. A remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code under the context of the process.
